overview_description.description:
Robocurve is an artificial intelligence and robotics infrastructure company that develops open-source evaluation frameworks and independent benchmarking platforms for robots and the AI models that control them. Organized as a public benefit corporation, the company focuses on measuring real-world robotic capabilities through standardized, reproducible evaluations that enable transparent comparisons across robotics systems and foundation models. Its mission is to provide objective benchmarks that help researchers, developers, and the public understand the progress of physical AI.

Its product portfolio includes Inspect Robots, an open-source evaluation framework for running AI models on robotic platforms, and World Evals, a catalog of real-world robotics benchmarks. Robocurve also develops domain-specific benchmarks such as KitchenBench for bimanual household manipulation and DataCenterBench for data center construction tasks. The company's tools support integrations with robotics ecosystems including ROS, Isaac Lab, and vision-language-action models, enabling developers to evaluate robot performance across diverse embodiments and real-world tasks.
